properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Soft-start output means only the startup monitoring inhibition interval.
Startup, E-stop or no gap forces the alarm off.
Alarm requires post-startup continuous qualified gap.
Each suppressing condition clears or blocks gap qualification.
Persistent gap eventually alarms after startup and debounce, assuming advancing time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.startup: Elapsed time since the first invocation is less than 5 seconds.
atomic_propositions.gapQualified: Gap_Exceeded has remained TRUE with Weld_E_Stop_NC TRUE and !startup for at least DebounceTime, measured from first eligible invocation.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or observed output.
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB005(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
首拍时钟0；startup=clock<5s，急停不重启此时钟。gapPermit=!startup & Gap_Exceeded & Weld_E_Stop_NC；首次gapPermit真年龄0，假清起点；alarm=gapPermit且年龄>=固定正DebounceTime。两个期望输出为alarm、startup。
atomic_propositions.TimeTick: Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.
atomic_propositions.Operator_Alert: O[k].Operator_Alert: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Weld_Soft_Start_Active: O[k].Weld_Soft_Start_Active: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Operator_Alert=false, O_init.Weld_Soft_Start_Active=true.
